sections.title: Worry only about what you can change

items.q: Where did Thompson get his rule for worry?
items.a: His mother took him to **AA** around age **9**, and every meeting opened with the **Serenity Prayer**. If he **cannot affect it**, he **does not worry**. He tightens up only when the work **represents his family**.

items.q: What is a fasted hunt with a locked Yeti?
items.a: Friends pack food in a **Yeti**. **One of the wives holds the code** until someone texts a **photo of a kill**. The shortest lockout he remembers is **36 hours**; the longest about **4 days**. His own quarterly fasts run **2–3 days**, up to **7**.

items.q: What does he say kills most whitetail and elk hunters?
items.a: **Not understanding thermals.** Morning air **sinks**, then **rises as the slope heats**, and an animal below you **smells you** if you come from above. He killed the buck they called **the Monarch** at **35 yards** after walking to a face where the drift was right, then sat through about **25 minutes** of adrenaline.

items.q: What is the thermals feature for?
items.a: Use it **at home**: pick a **day and historical weather**, drop a pin, and see **how scent moves**. It changes with **canopy** (open hill versus **aspens**) and with **east versus west** slopes. On his best spots, drift from about **320 degrees** funnels into one pocket — an old buck **knows the whole mountain** before he steps on it. Then the phone goes in a **chest pocket**.

items.q: How did chaos theory turn into Jung?
items.a: He clicked a **Jordan Peterson** video to learn **chaos theory** for his wife and landed on **Carl Jung**. He still **writes dreams down**. His reading: as you become **more whole**, dreams get **fewer and denser**. He calls it a **useful heuristic**, not **CBT**.

items.q: How does Joe define kaizen here?
items.a: **Never-ending improvement on one thing.** He points at the **Nissan GT-R** — keep working one platform — and at a jiu-jitsu approach that treats skill the same way.

items.q: Why does Thompson want candidates to talk for three hours?
items.a: You **cannot sit for 3 hours and not reveal yourself**. Someone running for **high office** who will not do that on the biggest podcast, he says, should be **dispatched with**.

items.q: What moth experiment does he use for knowledge that survives a rewrite?
items.a: He describes a **lavender** scent paired with an **unpleasant vibration**. He says the moths still **avoided it after the cocoon** — the body turned to **mush** — and that the avoidance showed up in the **offspring**.
